note: Liechtensteinische Landesbank's price overview for accounts, cards and payment services (prices issued as at 1 June 2026, for clients at its Vaduz head office and Liechtenstein branches), before VAT: the LLB Light package, the smallest of its LLB Daily packages for adults, costs 4.90 francs a month.

sources.title: Liechtensteinische Landesbank, Overview of prices for accounts, cards and payment services (as at 1 June 2026)
sources.said: This price list applies to Liechtensteinische Landesbank AG’s clients who have their account at the bank’s head office in Vaduz or a local branch in Liechtenstein. ... are exclusive of any value-added tax ( VAT ). ... The prices shown were issued as at 01 June 2026. ... LLB Pro1 LLB Flex LLB Light ... Package price per month CHF 24.90 CHF 9.90 CHF 4.90
